title: Replicate-resolved pressure-cooling responses of tobacco mosaic virus coat protein reveal robust volumetric changes and non-dominant conformational redistribution.
authors: Bonafe, Carlos Francisco Sampaio; Teixeira, Juan Philippe; Cesar de Melo Freire, Caio; Bajay, Miklos Maximiliano; de Lima Neto, Daniel Ferreira
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟结合复制分析，研究烟草花叶病毒衣壳蛋白在高压和冷却条件下的体积变化与构象重分布，属于蛋白质结构计算模拟研究，方法严谨且聚焦于构象采样问题。
abstract: High hydrostatic pressure can alter protein structure through changes in system volume, hydration, packing, and conformational sampling. We combined a sequential pressure and pressure-cooling molecular-dynamics pathway for tobacco mosaic virus coat protein (TMVcp) with replicate-resolved analysis of Native (1 bar, 300 K), high hydrostatic pressure (HHP; 2500 bar, 300 K), and HHP plus low temperature (HHP+LT; 2500 bar, 255 K). Three independently velocity-initialised 20 ns replicates were analysed per condition after discarding the first 200 ps, yielding 89,109 frames. Relative to Native, mean box volume decreased by 9.15% under HHP and 11.49% under HHP+LT, while density increased by 10.07% and 12.98%. Water occupancy within 0.35 nm increased by 10.73% and 18.45%, respectively; after normalization for bulk densification, the residual increase was near-null for HHP (+0.6%) but persisted for HHP+LT (+4.9%). In pooled Cartesian PCA, PC1-PC2 captured 38.5% of total variance but did not separate same-condition from across-condition replicate pairs (Jensen-Shannon divergence 0.771 versus 0.768; p = 0.476). Condition-associated signal instead concentrated in PC3-PC4, with mean divergence of 0.545 within conditions and 0.773 across conditions; selection-aware exact permutation retained significance (p = 0.0143). Pairwise C-alpha RMSD and backbone-dihedral PCA supported condition-associated differences, although first-half versus second-half divergences indicated incomplete convergence. Endpoint epitope comparisons showed residue-level enrichment for Native and HHP+LT, but not HHP. Overall, TMVcp exhibited robust volumetric responses, condition-dependent near-protein hydration, and reproducible but non-dominant conformational redistribution without implying equilibrium convergence or causal antibody remodelling. These findings distinguish pressure-driven densification from cooling-associated local hydration effects while preserving appropriate mechanistic caution.
abstract_zh: 高静水压力可通过系统体积、水合作用、堆积及构象采样的变化改变蛋白质结构。我们将烟草花叶病毒外壳蛋白（TMVcp）的序贯压力与压力冷却分子动力学路径，结合对天然态（1 bar，300 K）、高静水压力（HHP；2500 bar，300 K）及高静水压力加低温（HHP+LT；2500 bar，255 K）的重复解析分析。每个条件下分析了三个独立速度初始化的20 ns重复，丢弃前200 ps后，共获得89,109帧。相对于天然态，平均盒子体积在HHP下减少9.15%，在HHP+LT下减少11.49%，而密度分别增加10.07%和12.98%。0.35 nm内的水占据分别增加10.73%和18.45%；经体相致密化归一化后，残余增加在HHP下接近零（+0.6%），但在HHP+LT下持续存在（+4.9%）。在合并的笛卡尔PCA中，PC1-PC2捕获了总方差的38.5%，但未区分同条件与跨条件的重复对（Jensen-Shannon散度分别为0.771和0.768；p = 0.476）。条件相关信号反而集中在PC3-PC4中，条件内平均散度为0.545，条件间为0.773；选择感知精确置换保持显著性（p = 0.0143）。成对C-alpha RMSD和主链二面角PCA支持条件相关差异，尽管前半段与后半段的散度表明收敛不完全。终点表位比较显示天然态和HHP+LT存在残基水平富集，但HHP无此现象。总体而言，TMVcp表现出稳健的体积响应、条件依赖的近蛋白水合作用及可重复但非主导的构象重分布，而不暗示平衡收敛或因果性抗体重塑。这些发现区分了压力驱动的致密化与冷却相关的局部水合效应，同时保持了适当的机制谨慎性。
